conclusion: Policy repeats an upward trajectory at the fixed training XY; the environment accepts a Cartesian box containing infeasible poses, then IK correctly rejects the requests. Random object-position adaptation is insufficient.
geometric_task_check: 31/100 translated grasp poses require a +10cm wrist displacement beyond the fixed-orientation reach upper bound by more than 3mm. This is a check of the current grasp offset, not proof that those objects cannot be grasped with another pose.
recommended_fixes: Update visual-guided pregrasp targets and generate random-position demonstrations.
Filter complete approach/grasp/lift paths for reachability before sampling.
Project actions to reachable workspace; penalize rejected requests and continued upward commands during hold.
method: Exact replay of seeds 30000-30099 matches the original total of 5185 failed requests. Geometric classification accounts for the weighted position/orientation residual tolerance. The remaining 14 targets were re-solved with multiple initial guesses; none passed. No global-unreachability claim is made solely from optimizer failure.
